The Art of Document Conversion

A Regression Test Document

By Test Author

Chapter 1: Text Formatting

This document tests various formatting elements to ensure conversion quality. It includes bold text, italic text, underlined text, and strikethrough text. Formatting can also be combined for bold italic.

Superscript works like this: E = mc2 and subscript: H2O is water.

1.1 Paragraphs and Alignment

This is a left-aligned paragraph with enough text to demonstrate proper word wrapping and paragraph spacing in the converted output. The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit.

This paragraph is centered.

This paragraph is right-aligned.

1.2 Special Characters

Smart quotes: "Hello, World!" and 'single quotes' should be preserved. Em dash — and en dash – are important typographic elements. Ellipsis… and bullet points • should also work correctly.

International characters: café, naïve, résumé, über, señor, Ångström.

Mathematical symbols: ± × ÷ ≤ ≥ ≠ ≈ © ® ™ § ¶ °

Chapter 2: Lists

2.1 Unordered Lists

  • First item in the unordered list
  • Second item with bold text
  • Third item with italic text
  • Fourth item with a longer description that should wrap properly when rendered in the output format

2.2 Ordered Lists

  1. First numbered item
  2. Second numbered item
  3. Third numbered item with formatting
  4. Fourth numbered item

2.3 Nested Lists

  • Top level item
    • Nested item one
    • Nested item two
  • Another top level item
    1. Nested ordered one
    2. Nested ordered two

2.4 Definition Lists

EPUB
Electronic Publication, a widely-used ebook format
PDF
Portable Document Format, preserves layout and formatting
MOBI
Mobipocket format, used by older Kindle devices

Chapter 3: Tables

Format Type Features
EPUB Reflowable Most widely supported format
PDF Fixed layout Preserves exact formatting
DOCX Word processing Editable document format
FB2 Structured XML Popular in Eastern Europe
MOBI Reflowable Amazon Kindle format

4.2 Preformatted Text

def convert_ebook(input_path, output_path):
    """Convert an ebook from one format to another."""
    plumber = Plumber(input_path, output_path)
    plumber.run()
    return output_path

4.3 Code Inline

Use the convert() function to transform documents. The Plumber class handles the conversion pipeline.

Chapter 6: Content Verification

This section contains specific text markers that regression tests can search for to verify content preservation:

MARKER_BOLD: This text must be bold

MARKER_ITALIC: This text must be italic

MARKER_HEADING: The heading "Chapter 6: Content Verification" must appear

MARKER_TABLE: The table must contain "EPUB", "PDF", "DOCX", "FB2", "MOBI"

MARKER_LIST: The list must contain "First item in the unordered list"

MARKER_BLOCKQUOTE: The blockquote must contain "Alan Kay"

MARKER_PREFORMATTED: The code block must contain "convert_ebook"

MARKER_LINK: The link to "calibre-ebook.com" must be present

MARKER_SPECIAL: café, résumé, naïve must be preserved

MARKER_SUPERSCRIPT: E = mc2 with superscript must be present
